tools.name: get_class_diagram
tools.description: Generates a Mermaid class diagram for the types defined in a specific C# file, with options to discover inheritance and related types in the workspace.

filePath.description: The absolute path to the .cs file to analyze.

includeInheritance.description: Whether to search the workspace for base classes and interfaces.

includeDependencies.description: Whether to search for and include other classes used as properties or fields.

depth.description: How many levels of relationships to follow (default: 1).
